# SYSTEM PROMPT — CODING AGENT BRIEF **Build the complete "MANDALA — Radial Symmetry Studio" landing page. Production-grade code, delivered on the first attempt, in exactly three files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`.** --- ## 0. PROJECT BRIEF - Deliver a **single-page, artistic/creative landing page** for *Mandala*, a fictional radial-symmetry design studio. - Visual identity: **2020s contemporary glassmorphism** — translucent glass panels floating over luminous indigo/periwinkle gradient fields, concentric radial "mandala" motifs, soft glows, generous rounded geometry, serene and precise. - **Mode exception (explicit):** the source spec designates **Light as the primary mode** — Light is the default presentation. **Dark Mode remains mandatory** and must be fully tokenized, styled, persisted, and toggleable. - **Framework exception (explicit):** per the zero-build, three-file deliverable, use **hand-authored custom CSS** (the sanctioned "clean custom CSS" path). Do **not** add Tailwind, any framework CDN, or any build step. - Required sections, in order: sticky header (page chrome + theme toggle), Hero, Features (3 cards), How It Works (3 steps), Testimonials, Pricing (3 tiers), FAQ, Final CTA, Footer with secondary links. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **No inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID selectors only:** every design property, layout rule, and state is targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML modifications:** markup stays semantic and style-agnostic (5 landmarks, one `

`, heading hierarchy in order). Changing the theme must require editing CSS only. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens - Store **all** visual tokens in `:root` and the dark-theme selectors. These tokens are **mandatory**: `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`. - **Contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token with a light text token — in both themes. Concrete values are fixed in §5.2; do not deviate. - **Light background:** never pure white. The light page surface is `#e9ecf7`; if a near-white surface is ever needed, use `#fefefe`, never `#ffffff`. - **Geometry, depth, motion, stacking tokens (mandatory):** `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`, `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`. Define all of them even if unused, to prevent stacking conflicts. - **No hard-coded colors, sizes, or durations in rules** — reference `var(--...)` everywhere. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support - Define dark tokens under **both** `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (as the flash-free, no-JS fallback) **and** a `.dark` class on ``. Keep both dark token blocks identical. - JS must set an explicit class (`.dark` or `.light`) on `` at boot: **localStorage first**, else `matchMedia` system preference, else Light. The class must win over the media query so stored preferences always apply. - The theme switch must animate seamlessly (transition background/color tokens); set `color-scheme` correctly per theme. - **Persistence + toggle:** user choice persists via `localStorage`; a visible toggle in the header shows the correct `aria-pressed` state and a descriptive `aria-label` (e.g., "Switch to dark theme"). ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - Build all layout structure with **Flexbox** (`display: flex`). Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless a documented exception exists (e.g., stretched pricing cards — justify it in a CSS comment). - **Mobile-first:** multi-column rows collapse to columns below 768px; no fixed widths; **no horizontal scrolling at any viewport from 320px to 1920px**. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) - Load **Google Fonts** via ``: **"Fraunces"** for display headings (`--font-display`) and **"Inter"** for body/UI (`--font-base`). No other font sources. - Icons: **Google Material Symbols (Rounded style)** via the standard stylesheet, using `icon_name`. - **Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are explicitly forbidden** — including for the mandala ornaments, glows, and avatars: generate every ornament with pure CSS gradients (§5.4). Verify each icon name exists in Material Symbols Rounded. ### 1.5 — *(folded into §0 framework exception: custom CSS, BEM naming, no utility-class mixing.)* --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Button Component (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--sm`) - **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` pill radius; minimum touch target **44×44px**; font-weight 600; Google Icon where semantically meaningful (e.g., `arrow_forward` on CTAs). - **Hover:** brightness/glow shift, `cursor: pointer` (gate hover styles behind `@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`). - **Focus:** distinct `:focus-visible` ring built from tokens (2px outline + soft glow shadow). - **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` feedback. - **Loading (`.is-loading`):** button is `disabled`, `aria-busy="true"`, `pointer-events: none`, double-clicks impossible; a CSS-only conic-gradient spinner appears absolutely centered via a pseudo-element **without changing button dimensions**; label dims to 0.35 opacity. - **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. - **Success/Error (`.is-success`, `.is-error`):** temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` (border + icon + adjacent message — never color alone). ### 2.2 Card Component (`.card`, glass surface) - **Default:** flexbox layout, glass styling per §5.3, 1px `--glass-border`, elevation from tokens. - **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus intensified glow. - **Focus-within:** card border highlights when a child link/button receives focus. - **Loading (Skeleton):** define a `.skeleton` shimmer keyframe utility in CSS (linear-gradient sweep) for reuse; it must not cause layout jumps. - **Empty state:** not required (no async content on this page) — do not invent empty content. ### 2.3 Form & Input (Final CTA email capture) - **Structure:** flex container wrapping a programmatically associated `
